author: gonzatti
quote:
Some games stay with you. Others grow with you. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time has managed to do both.  
This is not a first-impressions review. I've completed both the original Nintendo 64 version and the Nintendo Switch 2 version. I've experienced the entire journey twice, years apart, and this is my endgame perspective after seeing the credits roll on both. I can say that the newer version didn't just bring back childhood memories.. it gave me another reason to appreciate what makes this game so timeless.
Coming back to it as an adult feels different. The world is familiar, but I understand its themes in a way I couldn't before. The passage of time, the weight of responsibility, the losts, and the realization that growing up means leaving parts of yourself behind. The transition from Child Link to Adult Link is more than a gameplay mechanic. It is the heart of the story and perhaps the reason this game means even more to me today. The Nintendo Switch 2 version gives this classic the treatment it deserves. The rebuilt visuals, soundtrack, expanded cinematics, updated controls, and Brazilian Portuguese localization make the experience feel fresh without losing what made the original special.  It doesn't simply rely on nostalgia, it gives an old masterpiece room to shine again. There is also a personal side to this purchase that matters. I am playing this as a Brazilian, where owning the hardware and the game is not a small expense. For perspective, the combined cost is equivalent to just over three Brazilian minimum monthly wages, or approximately 1.4 months of the country's average monthly income. But after experiencing the game again, I can honestly say it was worth it.Ocarina of Time was the best game of my childhood. Somehow, decades later, it has become the best game of my adulthood too. Maybe that's the real magic of this journey, Link grows up, and so do we. Hyrule remains, but the person returning to it is no longer the same. Some adventures never really end. They simply wait for us to grow old enough to understand them.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: gonzatti
quote: In the end, Stellar Blade stands as a testament to what happens when a game prioritizes quality over trends. From its meticulously crafted gameplay mechanics to the breathtaking visuals and immersive world-building, every element of the experience exudes a level of care and dedication that is rare in today’s gaming landscape. The PS5 PRO version is a masterpiece. The combat is fluid, rewarding, and deeply engaging, pushing players to master its intricacies rather than relying on superficial accessibility. The attention to detail, from character animations to environmental storytelling, showcases a clear passion for game design that resonates throughout the entire journey.What truly sets Stellar Blade apart, however, is its unapologetic commitment to artistic vision. Unlike many modern titles that dilute their creative direction to adhere to fleeting cultural trends, Stellar Blade remains steadfast in delivering a pure, uncompromised experience. It doesn’t seek to please everyone; it seeks to be excellent. And in doing so, it has carved out a space for itself as a shining example of what happens when developers focus on craftsmanship first. In an industry often burdened by external pressures, Stellar Blade is a refreshing reminder that quality and vision still matter. It’s a game made for players, by developers who clearly love what they do. And ultimately, that’s what makes it stand out—not just as a great game, but as a statement.
